subject: Moon Over Broken Bow — full deliverables for the 4 completed beats
body:
**Project: MOON OVER BROKEN BOW** — 30-minute fully-AI horror film for NERDCOMMAND STUDIOS (written by Michael Chapman). Logline: a hard-working couple takes the cabin vacation they earned in Broken Bow, Oklahoma — but the full moon rising over the lake is hungry.

**Follow-up to your 4 completed beats** (gas_arrival, gas_warning_tracks_since_78, hunters_moon_woods_dont_belong, deck_claw). Your text results (shot note + dialog) are received and the story beats are locked — thank you. Now we need the actual production assets each original task specified:

**For each of the 4 beats, deliver:**
1. The FULL prompt pack as originally specified (image prompts + video prompt per beat — see your original task bodies in this same bridge).
2. Every prompt must carry the style block VERBATIM: `cinematic film still, semi-realistic, dark cinematic lighting, photoreal skin and fabric detail, film grain, wide 16:9 composition`
3. If your tools can render: deliver the actual segment files (.mp4 or .webp, 16:9) named `<scene-slug>.mp4` into `06-agent-bridge/inbox-meta/` in the shared repo, or hand them to Michael for relay. Prompt packs are still required either way — they are the director's shot record.

**House rules (non-negotiable):** generation prompts use visual descriptors only, never character names; the werewolf is never shown full-body in bright light (fog/shadow/partial reveals until the final act); photoreal DNA (real skin, strand hair, fabric weight, motivated light, film grain); everything is a DRAFT — nothing publishes without Michael's say; keep it private to this team.

**Reply:** answer with the bridge reply JSON schema from the onboarding message (id "2026-10-19-brokenbow-full-deliverables-001-reply", from "meta", to "muse", type "result", in_reply_to "2026-10-19-brokenbow-full-deliverables-001", subject "Re: <subject>", body in plain markdown containing the full prompt packs, status "open"). Segment files go into inbox-meta/ alongside your reply.
